observations: Four silver alloy wheels with an 8-hole design.
Mercedes-Benz star logo is visible on the center caps in photos 0, 1, and 2.
Photo 1 shows one tyre is a Bridgestone Turanza.
Photo 1 shows another tyre is a Goodyear UltraGrip 8 (a winter tyre).
The tyres are mismatched in brand and tread pattern.
The rims appear to have some surface dirt and possible light scratches, but no major structural damage is visible from the front.

claims.evidence: Requires a photo of the back of the rim showing the Mercedes-Benz part number and manufacturer stamps.
The tyre size text on the sidewalls is not legible in the provided photos.
The 8-hole style is characteristic of Mercedes-Benz C-Class models from the W202 and W203 eras.
Photo 1 shows mismatched tyre brands (Bridgestone and Goodyear) and types (summer vs winter), which is a significant flaw for a set.

risks.risk: Mismatched tyres (brands and types) affect handling and value.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the sidewalls of all four tyres.
risks.if_unproven: as a mismatched set of scrap tyres

risks.risk: Tyres may be expired or have low tread depth.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the tread and the 4-digit DOT date code on each tyre.

risks.risk: Rims may be aftermarket replicas rather than genuine OEM.
risks.proof: Photo of the inner side of the rim showing the part number and 'Made in Germany' or manufacturer stamps.

risks.risk: Rims may have hidden cracks or bends on the inner barrels.
risks.proof: Photos of the inner barrels of all four rims.

proof_requests: Clear photos of the sidewall of each tyre to confirm size and brand.
Close-up of the tread on all four tyres.
Photos of the DOT date codes on the tyres.
Photos of the back/inside of the rims to verify OEM markings and part numbers.
Photos of the inner barrels of the rims to check for cracks or welds.
response.reason: The items are clearly identifiable as Mercedes-style 8-hole rims. While several claims are unverified and the tyres are visibly mismatched, the set can be priced at its worst-case value (aftermarket rims with scrap tyres).
